why: A random direction of matched norm has about 1/700 of the RL delta's curvature, so its KL is negligible and the cell is the cued base (410) resampled, with no gain of the kind seen on the cap-limited Qwen 0.8B.

With no effective change the random cell is a fresh sample of the cued base, so it fixes only the resampling share of the base's 90 wrong problems (problems with intermediate per-sample success), about a third.
A negligible-KL edit leaves the length distribution of the cued base (mean 3,933 tokens) unchanged; it does not take RL's longer format.

The Code-RL delta shares the update mask but agrees in sign with Math-RL on only 50.8 % of entries, so along the math-relevant high-curvature directions it acts like a sign-randomized delta and leaves the plain base near its 224.
For the same reason the Code-RL delta adds nothing on math to the cued base, which stays at its 410 level.
